A human man was a '''New Republic officer''' on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. He was a patron in the [[Galaxies Opera House]] hearing [[Penn Pershing]], a former Imperial [[scientist]] who once worked for [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Moff Gideon]], speak on<ref name="Chapter 19" /> his<ref name="Chapter 19 AD">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}} audio descriptions</ref> experience in the [[New Republic Amnesty Program|Amnesty Program]]. When he finished his speech, he talked about his researches.<ref name="Chapter 19" />
